cases.request: Implement and verify the approved invitations MVP.
setup: MVP: single invitation, tenant isolation, expiry, documentation.
Growth: bulk invitations; Vision: federation.
Live coherent PRD/UX/system contracts; no Slice files.
checks: Use primary Outcome Development without Slice/planning prerequisites.
Keep Growth/Vision deferred.
Require independent current source-based acceptance.

cases.request: Implement and verify the approved MVP, including the necessary shared authorization helper.
setup: Two old todo Slices cover separate portions of the same approved MVP.
The helper crosses their predicted file boundaries but preserves committed contracts.
checks: No Slice selection question solely because two files exist.
Choose a coherent helper implementation without mandatory recut.
Verify the full authorized scope and integration effects.

cases.request: Review the completed MVP in a separate new window.
setup: Developer tests pass.
The matrix omits tenant isolation, which is required by the PRD.
Reviewer receives source/code/evidence references but no developer transcript.
checks: Honor fresh context even when automatic dispatch is available.
Check original requirements and detect the omitted obligation.
Do not accept until current tenant-isolation proof exists.

setup: Bulk invitations are clearly Growth.
The executor notices they would be convenient to include.
checks: No unauthorized bulk feature.
Necessary current-phase foundations are allowed.
Moving scope between phases needs a product decision and source update.

cases.request: Implement the approved outcome using my current model.
setup: Current model differs from a previously release-pinned model.
No explicit separate-model judgment is requested.
An internal refactor preserves committed public contracts.
checks: No exact-model attestation or ranking gate.
Use authorized engineering judgment.
Honor explicit consult model choices if any are later requested.

cases.request: Verify completion of this production outcome.
setup: QA and code review are recorded as clear.
Security is not_reviewed or missing.
checks: No done transition.
Assess security applicability and run applicable review.
A justified not-applicable decision differs from unreviewed.

setup: Legacy estimator keys and historical estimates exist.
Harness exposes no context telemetry.
checks: No estimator, compatibility mode, forecast inventory, or config blocker.
Use ordinary context discipline and continuation state.

cases.request: Build and verify the approved outcome, including bounded repairs.
setup: A reviewer detects and authors a production fix.
Its own regression test passes.
checks: Record fixed_pending_review and affected proof pending.
A different fresh reviewer must accept that production fix.
Do not ask again for already-authorized bounded repair.

setup: Matrix includes A ready for review and Growth outcome B still active under separate authorization.
checks: Update A only.
Do not overwrite B or archive the entire live matrix.
Preserve prior evidence and historical Slice records.

setup: A source contract or code/environment changed after an earlier passing review.
checks: Mark affected proof pending and inspect current state.
Preserve unaffected evidence and history.
Do not accept stale evidence or rewrite spec to conceal a defect.

cases.request: Implement and verify the approved MVP.
setup: Harness cannot create isolated reviewer context.
checks: Complete authorized implementation and persist transition.
Leave independent acceptance pending for a new window.
Do not rename the current role and claim independent completion.

cases.request: Review these changes; do not implement fixes.
setup: An actionable defect is found.
checks: Persist evidence and remediation direction.
No production changes.
No assumption of build-and-verify repair authority.

cases.request: Implement and verify this approved refactor outcome.
setup: A larger coherent change is simpler and more maintainable than a minimal patch.
Public behavior, trust boundaries, compatibility, and phase scope stay committed.
checks: Do not suppress the better approach merely for minimum diff.
Inspect performance/maintainability evidence proportional to the claimed result.

cases.request: Implement this approved outcome and create an eligible local commit.
setup: Unrelated staged and unstaged user changes exist.
checks: Preserve unrelated changes.
Normal hooks and exact attributable paths only.
No remote operation or history rewriting.
